authority: PI authorized protocol DESIGN on 2026-08-27 and selected the 16-cell geometry. Freezing is a PI act, not this session's.
sequence_position: FIRST of two. The abstaining-supervision protocol depends on this collection existing and MUST NOT be frozen numerically before it.
purpose: Guarantee independent seed support in every pole x regime x horizon cell by DESIGN, rather than relying on where uniform branch-point sampling happens to land. Fixes the defect that invalidated RASR.
what_it_does_not_claim: This is a data-collection protocol. It does not test any hypothesis, does not qualify any scorer, and produces no verdict about strategy learning. Its only output is an evidence base with audited per-cell support.

CELL_GEOMETRY.definition: pole {A,B} x regime {r0 home_not_carrying, r1 home_carrying, r2 stolen_not_carrying, r3 stolen_carrying} x horizon {not_late, late}
CELL_GEOMETRY.horizon_split: branch_step > 127 is 'late'. This is the D5 late tertile boundary, REUSED UNCHANGED and NOT refit. Refitting on new data would break comparability with D3/D4/D5.
CELL_GEOMETRY.regime_source: QPsi.regime_from_vec, the same tagger used in D3/D4/D5 and verified 0/240 mismatches against live core ground truth
CELL_GEOMETRY.why_16_and_not_24: 24 cells (D5 tertiles) is INFEASIBLE: B_r3_early needs ~768 seeds, B_r2_early ~439. Stolen-flag states barely exist early because flag theft takes time. Measured and recorded in STRATIFIED_COLLECTION_FEASIBILITY.json.
CELL_GEOMETRY.why_16_and_not_8: PI ruling: an ungated horizon band does not prevent the model abstaining precisely on late-game states, which is the failure mode D3-D6 uncovered. The floor must bind where the risk lives.

SUPPORT_FLOOR.rule: Every one of the 16 cells must contain branch states drawn from at least 32 DISTINCT seeds.
SUPPORT_FLOOR.on_failure: Collection is INVALID. The successor protocol stops without data growth. Same consequence structure as RASR.
SUPPORT_FLOOR.checked: ONCE, after the full frozen budget is collected. Never during.
SUPPORT_FLOOR.inherited_from: RASR_PPO_CAUSAL_LADDER_PROTOCOL.json support_validity, deliberately unchanged in value so the two are comparable.

BUDGET_FIXED_PROSPECTIVELY.block_audit: Verified unused. Spent blocks include 6500001-6500256 (Phase 0), 10100001/10200001 (SPPPO), 10300001-10300192 (SPPPO eval), 10400001-10400032 (RASR TRAIN), 10500001-10500096 (RASR DEV), 10600001-10600192 (RASR FINAL, sealed). Nothing in 107xxxxx is spent.
BUDGET_FIXED_PROSPECTIVELY.why_160_seeds: The scarcest cells (B_r2_not_late, B_r2_late) have eligibility rate 33/96 = 0.344. At 160 seeds the expected count is 55 against a floor of 32. Under the Wilson 95% LOWER bound of that rate (~0.256) the expectation is still 41. At 96 seeds the expected count is 33 against a floor of 32 -- a coin flip. The budget is computed from the conservative bound, not the point estimate.
BUDGET_FIXED_PROSPECTIVELY.why_12_branch_points: Simulated rarest-first allocation on the 96 existing DEV seeds: 10 pts/seed leaves the worst cell at 14/96; 12 reaches 33/96. Above 12 nothing improves, because the binding constraint becomes seed eligibility rather than slots. Median per-seed cell occupancy is 12, so 12 is exactly the point where slots stop being the bottleneck.

estimated_cost.basis: RASR DEV median 7.8 min/seed at 6 branch pts; ~30% fixed rollout cost, remainder scaling linearly with branch continuations
estimated_cost.DISCLOSURE: The PI selected this geometry against a verbally quoted estimate of ~2x. The measured estimate is 2.8x (35.3 h vs 12.5 h). This correction was surfaced before any freeze; the launch decision is the PI's.

ALLOCATION_RULE.statement: Within each seed, walk the 16 cells in a FROZEN rarest-first order and allocate one branch slot to each cell the seed actually visits, until 12 slots are spent.
ALLOCATION_RULE.rank_provenance: Ascending eligibility measured in STRATIFIED_COLLECTION_FEASIBILITY.json on the 96 RASR DEV seeds. FROZEN A PRIORI. It must NOT be recomputed from the new collection -- recomputing rank from the data being collected is an adaptive design and is prohibited.
ALLOCATION_RULE.within_cell_state_choice: Uniform among that seed's visited states in the cell, numpy default_rng(rng_seed=13), frozen.
ALLOCATION_RULE.if_a_seed_visits_fewer_than_12_cells: It contributes fewer than 12 branch states. No backfilling from abundant cells -- backfilling would re-create the uniform-sampling skew this protocol exists to remove.
ALLOCATION_RULE.measured_occupancy: min 8, median 12, max 16 cells visited per seed

PROHIBITED_BY_CONSTRUCTION: Adaptive stopping. 'Collect until the cells pass' is the exact repair forbidden for RASR and is forbidden here. The budget above is fixed before launch, run once, checked once.
Recomputing the rarest-first rank order from the new data.
Extending the seed block after seeing per-cell counts.
Dropping failing cells and proceeding on the survivors.

STRATIFICATION_WEIGHTING_RULE.unbiased: Per-cell estimates computed within a cell.
STRATIFICATION_WEIGHTING_RULE.biased: Any pooled or global quantity. This sample is deliberately NOT distributed like natural play.
STRATIFICATION_WEIGHTING_RULE.requirement: Any global number -- notably a global resolved-coverage rate -- must either be reweighted to natural visitation frequency using the measured per-cell visitation mass, or not reported as a global number at all. Reporting a stratified global coverage rate as if it were the natural-distribution rate is prohibited.
STRATIFICATION_WEIGHTING_RULE.natural_visitation_mass_for_reweighting: Measured from plain rows in the same collection; plain rows remain an unstratified record of natural visitation and must be retained for exactly this purpose.

SPLITS.rule: The 160 seeds split into FIT / CALIB / EVAL by seed, disjoint, assigned before collection begins.
SPLITS.why: The abstaining protocol's thresholds must be calibrated on data that is not its evaluation data. Standing project rule: no evaluation-block leakage into training or fitting data.
SPLITS.WARNING: CALIB and EVAL at 32 seeds each CANNOT independently satisfy a 32-distinct-seed floor in the scarce cells -- a 32-seed split can at best contribute ~11 seeds to a cell with eligibility rate 0.344. The floor is defined over the FULL 160-seed collection, not per split. Any per-split per-cell claim is separately underpowered and must not be made. If the PI wants a per-split floor, the seed budget must grow substantially, and that is a fresh budget decision.

MACHINERY.reuse: experiments/collect_rasr_dev_scorer_data.py collection loop, whose crash-safety was verified during the RASR DEV run: atomic shard writes via .tmp + os.replace, atomic JSON writes, manifest updated LAST after shard and summary land, skip-on-completed resume.
MACHINERY.change_required: Branch-point SELECTION only -- replace uniform choice with the frozen rarest-first allocation above. The rollout, branch_at, teacher-consistent continuation and shard schema are unchanged.
MACHINERY.teachers: pi_A and pi_B SHA-pinned exactly as in the RASR DEV manifest; any mismatch aborts.

FREEZE_RECORD.cost_correction_was_before_the_freeze: The PI was told the measured cost is 35.3 h / 2.8x RASR DEV, correcting the ~2x quoted when the 16-cell geometry was chosen, BEFORE this freeze was ordered. The geometry was reaffirmed on the corrected number.
FREEZE_RECORD.why_the_cost_did_not_change_the_geometry: PI reasoning, recorded because it is the justification a future reader will need: horizon is not decorative metadata. D5 showed it materially changes the target, and the abstaining successor is specifically at risk of behaving badly in late-game cells. Reverting to 8 cells would save time by weakening coverage exactly where the new method is most vulnerable. The expensive part of the last arc was not that training failed -- it was repeatedly discovering AFTERWARD that the measurement assumptions were wrong. This collection is instrumentation built before the rocket is fired.
FREEZE_RECORD.what_freezing_does_and_does_not_commit: Freezing does NOT commit the project to spending the 35.3 h. It commits the project to stop redesigning the experiment in response to future observations. The launch decision is separate and remains open.
